• Fix (iOS): Auto Sync now retries audio extraction through a separate mpv decoder when Apple's exporter cannot read a playable stream (including some torrent/MKV sources).
• It produces a temporary WAV sample for speech timing, then deletes it; playback continues unchanged.
• Privacy: Apple's online recognition still requires explicit consent. iOS 15+, English subtitles, seekable audio and supported mpv PCM output required. Some protected/live sources may fail.
